_why: Sync fixes before/after deck (2026-09-16): the error box's Try again (position + Syncing while it runs), the new over-limit files line, and the red Settings gear. Every state is a workbench-only override; nothing real is touched. Expectations accept the old OR the new screen so both runs verify; the deck compares the pictures.
